sentences.text: While the size of Arctic sea ice has dropped by about 40 percent over 40 years, until recently, the size of the sea ice around Antarctica was slowly increasing.

sentences.text: Then, after 2015, Antarctic ice extent (范围) fell from a record high to several record lows, losing an area as large as Greenland.
sentences.read: Then, after twenty fifteen, Antarctic ice extent fell from a record high to several record lows, losing an area as large as Greenland.

sentences.text: Some research has suggested that higher air temperatures may be the cause.

sentences.text: However, two new studies show that ocean warming played a bigger role in this dramatic change.

sentences.text: As part of global ocean circulation (全球海洋环流), warm saltwater moves southward from the tropics and circles Antarctica 200 metres below the surface.

sentences.text: But temperature and saltiness records of the past 20 years suggest that this warm deep saltwater has been rising towards the surface, where it can melt (融化) sea ice.

sentences.text: Antarctica is encircled by a belt of strong winds and storms.
sentences.read: Antarctica is encircled by a belt of strong winds and storms.

sentences.text: Climate change has pushed this storm belt southward, bringing more rain and snow into the sea ice area, according to a study by Earle Wilson and other researchers at Stanford University.
sentences.read: Climate change has pushed this storm belt southward, bringing more rain and snow into the sea ice area, according to a study by Earle Wilson and other researchers at Stanford University.

sentences.text: The rain and snow create a layer (层) of fresh surface water that better protects the bottom of the sea ice from warm deep saltwater, allowing it to grow to its 2014 record high.

sentences.text: But the same southward-moving storm belt also brings stronger winds.

sentences.text: These winds blow surface water and ice forward.

sentences.text: As this happens, warm deep saltwater rises up to fill the empty space.

sentences.text: Between 2014 and 2016, this wind-driven rising began to get the upper hand against the protective layer of increased rain and snow, and sea ice began to melt away.

sentences.text: When the researchers input the recorded ocean data (数据) into a computer model, it projected that sea ice would grow and then become smaller, as it did in the real world.

sentences.text: The researchers plan to study and model other things, which also likely play roles throughout Antarctica.
